## Finance Constraint Reminder
- Monetary values: `decimal.Decimal` (shopspring/decimal or equivalent) — NEVER `float64`
- PII fields: synthetic data only in tests
- All monetary assertions must specify expected decimal precision

---

## Monetary Fields

| Field | Type | Currency Precision | Min | Max | Zero | Negative | Null |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| amount | Decimal | GBP: 2dp, JPY: 0dp, BHD: 3dp | 0.01 (or 1 for JPY) | 999999999.99 | Test | Test (reject) | Test |
| fee | Decimal | Same as amount currency | 0.00 | % of amount | Test (allowed) | Test (reject) | Test |
| exchange_rate | Decimal | 6dp minimum | 0.000001 | 999999.999999 | Test (reject) | Test (reject) | Test |
| <!-- AGENT: add from BRD --> | | | | | | | |

**Rounding rule**: Round half-up to currency decimal places. Test: 0.005 → 0.01 (GBP), not 0.00.

## Account Identifier Fields

| Field | Type | Format | PII | Regulatory | Boundary Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| account_number_bsb | String | `XXX-XXX` (6 digits + hyphen) | Yes | Yes | Valid, invalid format, wrong length, null |
| account_number_iban | String | Country-specific (GB: 22 chars) | Yes | Yes | Valid, wrong checksum, wrong length, null |
| sort_code | String | `XX-XX-XX` (6 digits) | No | Yes | Valid, invalid format, null |
| swift_bic | String | 8 or 11 alphanumeric chars | No | Yes | 8-char, 11-char, invalid, null |
| account_name | String | Max 100 chars | Yes | No | Mismatch vs registered, null, empty |

## Transaction & Reference Fields

| Field | Type | Format | Regulatory | Boundary Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| transaction_id | UUID | RFC 4122 v4 | Yes (audit) | Null, duplicate (idempotency test) |
| transaction_date | Date | ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD | Yes | Past, today, future-dated, null |
| value_date | Date | ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD | Yes | Before transaction_date, same, future |
| currency_code | String | ISO 4217 3-char uppercase | Yes | Valid, deprecated (DEM), lowercase, 4-char, null |
| payment_reference | String | Max 35 chars, alphanumeric | Yes | Empty, 35 chars, 36 chars, special chars |
| <!-- AGENT: add from BRD --> | | | | |

## Audit Trail Fields

| Field | Type | Format | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| created_at | Timestamp | RFC 3339 UTC | Yes | Must be set on creation, immutable |
| updated_at | Timestamp | RFC 3339 UTC | Yes | Must update on every mutation |
| created_by | UUID | RFC 4122 v4 | Yes | Must reference valid user_id |
| correlation_id | UUID | RFC 4122 v4 | Yes | Propagated across service boundaries |
| request_id | UUID | RFC 4122 v4 | Yes | Unique per request |
| <!-- AGENT: add from BRD --> | | | | |

## Synthetic Data Generators Required (Go)

| Field | Generator | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| amount | `syntheticAmount(min, max, currency string) decimal.Decimal` | Respects currency precision |
| account_number_iban | `syntheticIBAN(countryCode string) string` | Valid checksum |
| swift_bic | `syntheticSWIFT() string` | Valid 8 or 11 char |
| account_number_bsb | `syntheticBSB() string` | `XXX-XXX` format |
| transaction_id | `uuid.New()` | Standard |
| correlation_id | `uuid.New()` | Propagated in test context |
